title: 1% Marine Spring Water Replenishing Toning Mist

details.description: Plum Marine Spring Water Toning Mist with amino acids and active minerals hydrates, cools and revitalises skin on the go.
details.usageInstructions: Spray on a clean face from a little distance and pat gently.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.
